description: WTGs must be spaced 1.15 miles apart in a grid layout.
context_quote: Turbines would be sited in a uniform east-west/north-south grid with 1.15 by 1.15-mile spacing.

description: Each WTG foundation footprint will permanently alter approximately 0.03 acres of benthic substrate.
context_quote: Each 39-ft (12-m) turbine foundation footprint would permanently alter approximately 0.03 acres of benthic substrate.

description: The OCS-DC will be founded on a steel jacket pile structure.
context_quote: The OCS-DC would be placed on an up to four-legged piled jacket foundation.

description: The offshore export cable will have a target burial depth of 3 to 7 feet.
context_quote: The SRWEC would be buried to a target depth of 3 to 7 feet.

description: The maximum total installed array cable length is approximately 180 miles.
context_quote: The maximum total installed array cable length is approximately 180 miles.

description: The onshore transmission cable will cross the Carmans River via HDD.
context_quote: The Onshore Transmission Cable will cross the Carmans River via HDD.

description: No pile installation will occur from January 1 to April 30.
context_quote: No pile installation will occur from 01 January to 30 April.

description: Vessels must not exceed 10 knots within the Block Island Sound Transit Lane.
context_quote: Vessel speeds for all project vessels shall not exceed 10 knots within the Block Island Sound Transit Lane.
